Progress tracker for long-running workflows

Source: R/progress_tracker.R
mysterycall_progress_tracker.Rd

Provides reusable helpers for emitting periodic progress updates across multi-stage workflows such as the end-to-end mystery caller pipeline. The tracker keeps a method-by-method breakdown, surfaces estimated completion times, and exposes convenience helpers for recording failures.

Usage

mysterycall_progress_tracker(
  steps,
  update_every = 300,
  quiet = getOption("mysterycall.quiet", FALSE)
)

Arguments

steps

Character vector naming each discrete method or stage.

update_every

Number of seconds between automatic status updates. The default (300 seconds) produces five-minute summaries.

quiet

Logical flag controlling console output. When TRUE, suppresses status messages.

Value

An S3 object of class "mysterycall_progress_tracker" wrapping an internal environment. The environment holds a records tibble with columns step, status (factor: "pending", "in_progress", "completed", "failed"), started_at, finished_at (POSIXct), quality (character), and note (character). Interact with it via mysterycall_progress_start(), mysterycall_progress_finish(), and mysterycall_progress_summary().

See also

Other logging: mysterycall_format_duration(), mysterycall_log_cache_hit(), mysterycall_log_error(), mysterycall_log_info(), mysterycall_log_progress(), mysterycall_log_save(), mysterycall_log_step(), mysterycall_log_step_complete(), mysterycall_log_success(), mysterycall_log_to_file(), mysterycall_log_warning(), mysterycall_progress_callback(), mysterycall_progress_finish(), mysterycall_progress_start(), mysterycall_progress_summary(), mysterycall_tracker_fail(), mysterycall_tracker_update(), mysterycall_use_quiet_logging(), mysterycall_workflow_end(), mysterycall_workflow_start()

Examples

tracker <- mysterycall:::mysterycall_progress_tracker(c("Geocode", "Validate", "Export"))
mysterycall:::mysterycall_progress_start(tracker, "Geocode")
#> [05:36:57] Started Geocode
#> [05:36:57] Progress: 0/3 steps complete (0.0%)
Sys.sleep(1)
mysterycall:::mysterycall_progress_finish(tracker, "Geocode", score = 0.95)
#> [05:36:58] Completed Geocode (high)
#> [05:36:58] Progress: 1/3 steps complete (33.3%) - ETA 05:37:00
